message.string_normalization: trim outer whitespace; preserve remaining UTF-8 code points
message.missing_authorization_id: empty string for activate; required for verify/deactivate/launch-ticket/ticket-consume
message.nonce: client-generated string, at least 8 characters, unique per request
message.request_id: header/body value after trim; header and body must match exactly
message.device_public_key: Ed25519 public key, exactly 32 decoded bytes, base64url; sign the normalized submitted encoding

verification.signature_input: JCS(message object) encoded as UTF-8 bytes
verification.no_replay: nonce is hashed and consumed once by the server
